UpdateMapCamera clamps camera translation plus current-player XY to the expanded source bounds and preserves camera Z translation.

GetMapScreenCoord maps actual CameraBase screen coordinates through the source gameswf rectangle in [left,right,top,bottom] order, including source Y inversion; source_map_project_marker_v1 composes the live CameraBase callback with this transform for positions returned by actual marker producers.

CreateMapCamera camera byte133=1, word136=0, float140=1, damping disabled, SetData constants, plus source SetData vector (0,0,1) and subsequent CameraLevel subobject vtable+276 override (-1,1,0) are recorded and applied in source order.

Map CameraLevel configuration is applied through the same loaded GameplayCameraRuntimeV11: byte133 enters the existing source map-mode update path, word136 is decoded as the requested-zoom float, and float140 enters automatic zoom; source Update/HandleZoom read those same semantic fields. SetData +316 stores the source camera horizontal-FOV-or-magnification scalar, +312 aspect, +304/+308 clip planes, and +276 up vector, then the direct map up-vector override. CameraBase::SetData bool arg is ignored by original body.
